## Explore the interactive Leaflet map

```{r leaflet-map, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# This map is actually generated by the R leaflet package.
locations <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, list(
  c("Massachusetts Institute of Technology", "Cambridge, USA", "North America", 42.3601, -71.0942, "Artificial intelligence · Robotics", "A landmark ecosystem for intelligent systems, computer vision, robotics and interdisciplinary engineering.", "https://www.mit.edu/"),
  c("Carnegie Mellon University", "Pittsburgh, USA", "North America", 40.4433, -79.9436, "Robotics · Autonomous systems", "Home to a globally recognized robotics research community spanning perception, autonomy and real-world systems.", "https://www.cmu.edu/"),
  c("Georgia Institute of Technology", "Atlanta, USA", "North America", 33.7756, -84.3963, "Machine learning · Engineering", "Engineering and computing research connecting machine intelligence with applications in the physical world.", "https://www.gatech.edu/"),
  c("University of Toronto", "Toronto, Canada", "North America", 43.6629, -79.3957, "Deep learning · AI research", "An influential center within the Toronto artificial intelligence and deep learning research ecosystem.", "https://www.utoronto.ca/"),
  c("ETH Zürich", "Zürich, Switzerland", "Europe", 47.3763, 8.548, "Robotics · Intelligent systems", "A European research powerhouse in autonomous systems, robotics, computer vision and engineering.", "https://ethz.ch/"),
  c("University of Oxford", "Oxford, United Kingdom", "Europe", 51.7548, -1.2544, "AI · Machine learning", "Research crossing foundational machine learning, computing, robotics and technology ethics.", "https://www.ox.ac.uk/"),
  c("Saarland University", "Saarbrücken, Germany", "Europe", 49.2558, 7.0438, "AI · Computer science", "Part of Saarbrücken’s concentrated computer science and artificial intelligence research community.", "https://www.uni-saarland.de/en/home.html"),
  c("Queensland University of Technology", "Brisbane, Australia", "Asia–Pacific", -27.4771, 153.0289, "Robotics · Applied AI", "An applied technology university with robotics and autonomous systems research links to real-world industry.", "https://www.qut.edu.au/"),
  c("UNSW Sydney", "Sydney, Australia", "Asia–Pacific", -33.9173, 151.2313, "AI · Mechatronics", "Engineering, computing and robotics research across intelligent hardware, algorithms and autonomous systems.", "https://www.unsw.edu.au/"),
  c("Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence", "Abu Dhabi, UAE", "Middle East", 24.4326, 54.6201, "Artificial intelligence research", "A university centered on AI research, including machine learning, computer vision and robotics-related fields.", "https://mbzuai.ac.ae/")
)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(locations) <- c("name", "city", "region", "lat", "lng", "focus", "description", "website")
locations$lat <- as.numeric(locations$lat)
locations$lng <- as.numeric(locations$lng)
locations$popup <- sprintf(
  "<div style='min-width:220px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif'><span style='font-size:10px;color:#759199;text-transform:uppercase'>%s</span><h3 style='margin:7px 0;color:#173747'>%s</h3><div style='color:#647d88'>%s</div><p style='font-size:12px;line-height:1.6'>%s</p><a href='%s' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' style='color:#078d7e'>Official website ↗</a></div>",
  locations$focus, locations$name, locations$city, locations$description, locations$website
)
regional_colors <- c("North America"="#0b9d91", "Europe"="#e5a04d", "Asia–Pacific"="#8d74d7", "Middle East"="#dc6e62")

m <- leaflet::leaflet(options=leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom=2, worldCopyJump=TRUE)) |>
  leaflet::addProviderTiles(leaflet::providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  leaflet::setView(lng=0, lat=23, zoom=2)
for (region_name in names(regional_colors)) {
  region_data <- locations[locations$region == region_name, , drop=FALSE]
  m <- leaflet::addCircleMarkers(m, data=region_data, lng=~lng, lat=~lat,
    popup=~popup, label=~name, group=region_name,
    radius=8, stroke=TRUE, color="#ffffff", weight=2,
    fillColor=unname(regional_colors[region_name]), fillOpacity=0.95)
}
m <- leaflet::addLayersControl(m, overlayGroups=names(regional_colors),
  options=leaflet::layersControlOptions(collapsed=FALSE))
m <- leaflet::addScaleBar(m, position="bottomleft")
m
```

<div class="note"><strong>Explore your way:</strong> Use the layer selector in the map to show or hide North America, Europe, Asia–Pacific or the Middle East. Click any colored marker for campus context and a link to its official website. This is a curated sample, not a university ranking.</div>

### What makes this map interesting?

Artificial intelligence is an international research effort. This atlas connects institutions working in machine learning, autonomous systems, robotics, computer vision and applied engineering. The color-coded layers let you compare how these ecosystems are distributed around the world.
